h2: Plumber & Pool Service in Sanur – Villa Care for Beachfront Homes
intro: Looking for a plumber and pool service in Sanur that understands what decades of sun and sea air do to villa infrastructure? Bali Fix handles everything from brittle PVC pipe replacements to salt-corroded pump motors across Sindhu, Semawang, Mertasari and beyond. Send a photo on WhatsApp and we will give you a clear quote before any work begins.

sections.h3: What Breaks Most Often in Sanur Villas
sections.text: Sanur's villas carry pipework from a different era. Original PVC fittings, now 15–20 years old, have turned brittle under constant sun exposure — joints that once held fine now weep or split. In Sindhu, Semawang and Mertasari, salt-laden sea air corrodes tap cartridges, gate hinges and pump motors well before their expected life. Brackish well water near the shoreline clogs sediment filters fast and builds scale inside heaters. These are the patterns behind most requests for a plumber and pool service in Sanur.

sections.h3: Most Requested Services in This Area
sections.text: Blocked drains and septic issues top the call list here. Small tanks paired with narrow pipes mean that paper, grease or an overdue pump-out quickly creates blockages and odours throughout the villa. Water heater repairs follow close behind — scale from brackish water kills heating elements on a predictable cycle. Pool owners in beachfront zones ask us to replace corroded ladders, clean salt-crusted equipment and rebalance chemistry after heavy rain. For anything beyond a quick fix, send photos over WhatsApp and we will scope it out.

We work across all of Sanur's residential pockets: Sanur Kaja, Sanur Kauh, Sindhu, Semawang, Mertasari and Batujimbar. Each has its own quirks — Sindhu and Semawang sit closest to the waterline so corrosion hits harder; Mertasari and Batujimbar tend toward older septic setups that need regular attention. Whether your villa is a two-bedroom near the beach or a larger compound further inland, the same team handles plumbing, pool care and general maintenance in one visit.

sections.h3: Seasonal Tips for Villa Owners Here
sections.text: During dry season (April–October) the sun intensifies UV damage on exposed pipes and accelerates salt crystallisation on outdoor fittings — a good window to inspect and replace brittle sections before wet months arrive. In rainy season (November–March), expect more drain blockages from leaf debris, higher humidity stressing electrical pump connections, and faster algae growth in pools left between cleanings. A quick WhatsApp message with a photo of any drip, smell or cloudy water lets us advise you before it becomes an emergency.

faq.q: How do I get a quote without calling anyone?
faq.a: Snap a photo of the issue — a leaking joint, a corroded fitting, a green pool — and send it over WhatsApp. We will look at it and give you a clear estimate based on what we see.

faq.q: Do you cover all parts of Sanur, including the quieter inland streets?
faq.a: Yes. From Sindhu and Semawang right by the waterline to Mertasari, Batujimbar and the Sanur Kaja / Kauh lanes, the same crew handles plumbing, pool work and general villa maintenance throughout.

faq.q: My septic tank smells again after last month's fix. What should I check first?
faq.a: Most repeat odours trace back to grease buildup in narrow pipes or a tank that simply needs pumping out sooner than expected. Send us a short video or photo of the vent area on WhatsApp and we can tell you whether it is a simple flush or a full pump-out job.
